title: Count the Number of Substrings With Dominant Ones
summary: Count substrings of a binary string where the number of ones is at least the square of the number of zeros.
officialConstraints: 1 <= s.length <= 4 * 10^4; s consists only of '0' and '1' (search summary citing leetcode.com).
examples: Only '101101' -> 16 was reported, by a search summary of the official-style page; mirror sites disagree on '00011'. Not verified.
visualizationNotes: Playback accepts strings up to 60 characters. Official limit 4 * 10^4 is not drawn.
